ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture is the “Headquarters Layout Map of China’s Logistics Enterprises,” using black dots of different sizes to indicate the number of headquarters. raw_record.question_text:
Read “Distribution Map of Logistics Enterprises in China.”

<image1>

Beijing and Shanghai have many logistics enterprise headquarters, and their scales are comparable. From the perspective of market conditions, what is the common advantage of the two places?
